verdict.rationale: First-party docs describe a Raw Event Export API that returns all stored events with full properties as JSONL and is recommended for high-volume exports. They also describe a Query API that returns the same calculated results as web-app reports (event filtering and breakdowns, user profiles, activity streams, cohorts) and JQL for custom JavaScript queries. Missing for 10: hands-on or independent corroboration of the query/export APIs (only a passing community note that the export policy is good), and a machine-readable OpenAPI spec (probe returned 404).
